text:
Pooja Verma (synthetic)
Full-stack bootcamp graduate, 2025

I completed a 24-week MERN bootcamp and built three full-stack apps. My capstone, a clinic appointment system, uses React on the front end and Node.js with Express on the back end, with MongoDB for storage and a REST API between them. I deployed it on Render and wrote the API docs. Before the bootcamp I worked two years in customer support, where I learned to explain technical issues to customers.

Skills: JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, HTML, CSS, Git
